Name: Data Governance Council
Description: Cross-functional council chaired by the Chief Data Officer. Owns the governance framework, approves policies and arbitrates cross-domain rules.

Name: Data Protection Office
Description: Office of the Data Protection Officer. Owns privacy and personal data retention rules (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA where applicable).

Name: Data Quality Office
Description: Owns data quality, reference data, identity and matching, and stewardship rules for all master data domains.

Name: Information Security Office
Description: Office of the Chief Information Security Officer. Owns access control, segregation of duties and data security rules aligned with ISO/IEC 27001.

Name: GxP Quality Assurance
Description: Quality assurance for GxP-regulated data and computerised systems (21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11). Owns the pharma extension rules.
